blocks.text: Seven-time world champion Lewis Hamilton admitted he botched a call over tires that cost him and Ferrari a second podium place at the Singapore Grand Prix on Sunday. Hamilton and teammate Charles Leclerc were both called in on lap 39 by Ferrari under a virtual safety car caused by Lance Stroll breaking down. Leclerc took advantage of a cheap second pit stop under the “VSC” to get rid of his medium tires for a fresh set of softs and eventually finished second.
